WITH mgmtUserListPage AS( SELECT * FROM( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT A.* ,ROWNUM AS RNUM FROM ( SELECT A.USER_ID , A.PW , A.USER_NM , A.DESK_DIV , A.EMAIL , A.HP_NO , A.POSITION ,(SELECT code_id FROM TB_M_CODE_MANAGEMENT WHERE parent_id ='POSITION' AND code_value = A.POSITION) AS POSITION_DESC , A.ROLE ,(SELECT code_id FROM TB_M_CODE_MANAGEMENT WHERE parent_id ='ROLE' AND code_value = A.ROLE) AS ROLE_DESC , A.MAIL_YN , DECODE(A.MAIL_YN,'Y','수신','미수신') AS MAIL_YN_DESC , A.SMS_YN , DECODE(A.SMS_YN,'Y','수신','미수신') AS SMS_YN_DESC , A.USER_COLOR , A.USER_AVATAR , A.CREATE_USER , TO_CHAR(A.CREATE_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') CREATE_DATE , A.MODIFY_USER , TO_CHAR(A.MODIFY_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') MODIFY_DATE , A.LANG , A.DEFAULTPAGE , B.MENU_NM AS DEFAULTPAGENAME , TO_CHAR(USE_END_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') USE_END_DATE , TO_CHAR(EXTENSION_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') EXTENSION_DATE , TO_CHAR(EMPLOYMENT_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') EMPLOYMENT_DATE , (CASE WHEN EXTENSION_DATE > USE_END_DATE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS EXTENSION_DIV , USE_YN , COUNT(*) OVER() TOTAL_COUNT FROM TB_M_USERINFO A LEFT JOIN TB_M_MENUCFG B ON A.DEFAULTPAGE = B.MENU_ID WHERE 1=1
AND A.USER_ID || A.USER_NM LIKE '%' || #{sel_userId} || '%'
AND A.USE_YN = #{sel_useYn}
ORDER BY EXTENSION_DIV DESC, UPPER(A.USER_ID) ASC ) A ) WHERE RNUM <= ${totalPagesize} ) WHERE RNUM > ${currentPageSize} ) SELECT * FROM mgmtUserListPage

SELECT A.USER_ID ,A.PW ,A.USER_NM ,A.DESK_DIV ,A.EMAIL ,A.HP_NO ,A.ROLE ,A.POSITION ,A.MAIL_YN ,A.SMS_YN ,A.USE_YN ,A.USER_COLOR ,A.USER_AVATAR ,A.LANG ,A.DEFAULTPAGE ,B.MENU_NM ,A.USE_STA_DATE ,A.USE_END_DATE ,TO_CHAR(A.EXTENSION_DATE,'YYYY-MM-dd') AS EXTENSION_DATE ,TO_CHAR(A.EMPLOYMENT_DATE,'YYYY-MM-dd') AS EMPLOYMENT_DATE ,A.CREATE_USER ,A.CREATE_DATE ,A.MODIFY_USER ,A.MODIFY_DATE ,COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT FROM TB_M_USERINFO A LEFT JOIN TB_M_MENUCFG B ON A.DEFAULTPAGE = B.MENU_ID WHERE USER_ID = #{in_userId}

SELECT USER_ID , PW , USER_NM , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT FROM TB_M_USERINFO WHERE USER_ID = #{in_userId}
AND EMAIL = #{in_userEmail}

/* 사용자의 구독 메뉴를 "상위메뉴 그룹별"로 정렬해 반환 */ WITH HIER AS ( SELECT m.MENU_SEQ, m.MENU_ID, m.MENU_NM, m.PARENT_ID, m.SORT_ORDER, /* 루트(최상위 메뉴)의 정렬키 */ CONNECT_BY_ROOT LPAD(TO_CHAR(m.SORT_ORDER), 5, '0') AS ROOT_SORT_KEY, /* 각 노드까지의 정렬 경로키: 상위 -> 하위 순서로 누적 */ SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(LPAD(TO_CHAR(m.SORT_ORDER), 5, '0'), '/') AS PATH_SORT_KEY FROM TB_M_MENUCFG m WHERE m.USE_FLAG = 'Y' START WITH m.PARENT_ID IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR m.MENU_SEQ = m.PARENT_ID ) SELECT h.MENU_ID AS VALUE, h.MENU_NM AS CODE FROM HIER h WHERE h.MENU_SEQ IN ( SELECT ms.MENU_SEQ FROM TB_M_MENU_SUBSCRIBE ms WHERE ms.USER_ID = #{in_loginId} ) ORDER BY h.ROOT_SORT_KEY, h.PATH_SORT_KEY
